citation.title: Acute Anaerobic Exercise Affects the Secretion of Asprosin, Irisin, and Other Cytokines – A Comparison Between Sexes

population.description: 10 healthy non-smoking men and 10 healthy Caucasian women, physically active, medically examined, no chronic disease; age and BMI are printed by sex only (men 21.64 ± 1.22 y, BMI 23.71 ± 1.58; women 22.64 ± 1.49 y, BMI 21.50 ± 1.84), so each is given in its protocol's population and the pooled group is left null.

protocols.name: men_fasting
protocols.description: Men (n = 10): the fasting glucose of the medical examination (Table 1; sample type and method not printed), entered as a 30 min fasted run-in ending at the sample; clock, run-in and fast length not printed (08:00, 30 min and 10 h assumed)

protocols.name: women_fasting
protocols.description: Women (n = 10): the fasting glucose of the medical examination (Table 1; sample type and method not printed), entered as a 30 min fasted run-in ending at the sample; clock, run-in and fast length not printed (08:00, 30 min and 10 h assumed)
